findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Realign the leaf to parent e47b AC2: either update the parent AC2 to name the `docs/calibration` -> `evals/calibration` move and reconcile its grep carve-out set (including the dropped `tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py` and added `evals`/`CHANGELOG.md`/`.test_durations`), or narrow the leaf to move only `docs/experiments` as the parent declares.
evidence: Parent e47b AC2: 'The research corpus (the docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/ tree) is moved to a top-level evals/ directory' and its grep is `git grep -n 'docs/experiments' -- src docs scripts tests .github ...` with carve-outs that include `:!tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py` and do NOT include evals/CHANGELOG.md/.test_durations
Parent description never mentions docs/calibration
Leaf Approach: 'git mv docs/experiments evals && git mv docs/calibration evals/calibration'
Leaf AC2 grep: `git grep -n 'docs/experiments\|docs/calibration' ... ':!evals' ... ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!.test_durations'` and omits the parent's `:!tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py`
divergence-kind: incomplete_enumeration — parent goal 'research corpus out of docs' still holds and no parent AC is contradicted; the expansion is additive, so this is coached not auto-blocked
findings.finding: The leaf expands the corpus move beyond the parent's declared scope: parent e47b AC2 scopes only the `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/` tree and its verification grep is `git grep -n 'docs/experiments'`, but the leaf also moves `docs/calibration/` to `evals/calibration/` and reshapes AC2's grep (adds the `docs/calibration` alternation; adds `:!evals`, `:!CHANGELOG.md`, `:!.test_durations` carve-outs; and drops the `:!tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py` carve-out the parent explicitly lists). The `docs/calibration` move is work the parent AC2 neither names nor verifies.
scenarios: Parent epic's AC2 is marked done by the corpus-move story, but the parent's own AC2 grep would never have caught a lingering docs/calibration reference, so the parent's acceptance text no longer describes what was actually delivered.
A later reader reconciling parent AC2 against the leaf finds the carve-out sets diverge (packaging-dependencies carve-out present in parent, absent in leaf) with no recorded rationale.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Qualify the relative-link worklist paths with their `docs/` prefix (docs/README.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/llm-framework.md) so the shorthand cannot be confused with a repo-root README.md.
evidence: Approach: 'README.md:129,141 (7 links), architecture.md:310,312, llm-framework.md:80,81'
AC5: 'git diff -U0 -- docs/README.md has exactly two hunks'
grep scope '](experiments/\|](calibration/' -- 'docs/*.md' implies docs/README.md
findings.finding: The relative-link worklist names the docs files without their `docs/` prefix ('README.md:129,141', 'architecture.md:310,312', 'llm-framework.md:80,81'), while AC5 refers to 'docs/README.md'. Since a root-level README.md typically also exists, the bare 'README.md' is ambiguous about which file is edited; only the grep scope `-- 'docs/*.md'` disambiguates it.
scenarios: An executor edits the repo-root README.md instead of docs/README.md
findings.suggested_fix: Write 'docs/README.md:129,141', 'docs/architecture.md:310,312', 'docs/llm-framework.md:80,81' to match AC5 and the grep scope.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Capture the `evals/` convention (non-shipped, off sys.path, CodeQL-excluded, research-record frozen) in architecture.md or an ADR, and add a criterion that verifies the rationale is documented.
evidence: 'CodeQL — load-bearing ... evals/** must be added under paths-ignore'
'legacy_v4_baseline.py stays the v4 formula's importable home because evals/ is not on sys.path'
No AC asserts the convention is documented; architecture.md is only repointed, not shown to explain the new tree's purpose
findings.finding: The plan introduces a new, durable layout convention — a non-shipped top-level `evals/` tree deliberately off `sys.path` and excluded from CodeQL — but no acceptance criterion or step captures the RATIONALE for this convention in an ADR / AGENTS.md / design-doc, only incidental edits to architecture.md. A future contributor may re-add evals/ to packaging or docs link-checking without knowing why it was carved out.
findings.location: Approach / Scope — CodeQL and packaging carve-outs
scenarios: A later packaging change re-adds the tree to the wheel or CodeQL scan because the reason it was excluded is undocumented
findings.suggested_fix: Add a short section to architecture.md stating why evals/ is a non-shipped top-level tree and add an AC that greps for it, or write a one-line ADR.
